crash_resolution.symptom: zig build sig crashed in build_runner: constructGraphAndCheckForDependencyLoop -> shuffleWithIndex panic 'index out of bounds: index 31, len 31' (Random.zig:375); DETERMINISTIC across seeds (0x6d3244c9, 0xe098cf9d)
crash_resolution.root_cause: Rosetta mis-emulates the PRNG used by Zig 0.15.2's build_runner rejection sampling in uintLessThan; SIG's native x86_64 CI passes, so the bug is host-emulation-induced, not SIG source
crash_resolution.fix: Builder stage uses --platform=$BUILDPLATFORM so the build_runner runs as NATIVE arm64 code (no Rosetta); -Dtarget still cross-compiles the output to x86_64-linux-gnu.2.36 via zig cc
crash_resolution.verification: native arm64 Zig 0.15.2 cross-compile (aarch64-macos) produced an identical working x86-64 ELF before the Dockerfile change
